data.title: 信浓 · 月下寝殿的半透挽留
data.description: 夜色深沉月光照进寝殿，半透天青丝绸睡袍滑落肩头。信浓金色兽瞳中漾着如梦似幻的水光，蓬松白狐尾轻轻缠住你的手腕，柔声唤你入榻，满室旖旎。
data.location: moonlit traditional bedchamber with sliding shoji doors
data.action: sitting on edge of bed, sheer gown sliding off shoulders, glowing golden eyes full of desire, soft tail curling around partner wrist pulling forward
data.lighting: ethereal silver moonlight illuminating sheer translucent fabrics
data.mood: seductive divine yearning, heart-racing temptation, gentle surrender
data.promptProse: Sitting on the bed under pale moonlight, Shinano lets her sheer nightgown slip off her shoulder as a fluffy tail curls around partner wrist.
data.animaCaption: Shinano in a sheer off-shoulder gown pulling partner close with a fox tail.
